title: Constant complexes and their localized normalization square
statement: Let X,Z,T,S be schemes, g:Z→X, a:T→S and b:Z→T arbitrary scheme morphisms, and d an adic coefficient datum on A. Write L_n for fixed-B_n inverse image along b followed by lisseTowerFixedRealization(g,d,n). For the constructed scalar of [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-pulled-scalar], there exist isomorphisms model_n(E):L_n(localProEtaleComparison(a,B_n)(normalizationConstant(S.smallEtaleTopology)(E)))≅constantAdicQuotientRealization(g,d,n)(E) for every algebraic E in D(B_n). After restricting to completion coefficients and composing with inverse constantAdicQuotientRightIso [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison], write these comparisons as c_j. For every semilinear algebraic arrow k:E→Res(q_n)Eprime, H_(n+1)L_(n+1)(localProEtaleNormalization(normalizationConstantArrow(k))) followed by the constructed scalar and c_n equals c_(n+1) followed by constantAdicFiniteRealization(lisseTowerAlgebraArrow(k)), with exactly the specified compositors. No actual tower, descended D, etale delta or descent equation is assumed.

proof.text: Construct natural constant model comparisons jointly with the coefficient identity checked only at Q(K), for represented cochain complexes K. The family is not obtained from mere objectwise nonemptiness.

Take the component of each natural isomorphism at E. Apply the normalization criterion, which proves the equation for arbitrary derived k by localization extensionality and naturality. Pair these components and the equation; the existential statement remains verbatim.

theorem lisseTower_localized_constants
    {X Z T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ S) (b : Z ⟶ T)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :
    let L (j : ℕ) := (ProEtale.upperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d j)) b).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        lisseTowerFixedRealization g d j
    ∃ model : ∀ (n : ℕ)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))),
    (L n).obj ((localProEtaleComparison a
      (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj
        ((normalizationConstant S.smallEtaleTopology).obj E)) ≅
      (constantAdicQuotientRealization g d n).obj E,
    ∀ (n : ℕ)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d (n + 1))))
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (k : E ⟶ (normalizationModuleRestrict (lisseTowerEtaleQuotient d n)).obj E'),
    let H (j : ℕ) := pbcDerivedRestrict (constantAdicFiniteProjection g d j)
    let c (j : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d j))) :=
      (H j).mapIso (model j N) ≪≫
        ((constantAdicQuotientRightIso g d j).app N).symm
    (H (n + 1)).map ((L (n + 1)).map
      (localProEtaleNormalization a (lisseTowerEtaleQuotient d n)
        (normalizationConstantArrow S.smallEtaleTopology (lisseTowerEtaleQuotient d n)
          k))) ≫
      (lisseTowerPulledScalarIso g b d n).hom.app
      ((localProEtaleComparison a
        (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj
          ((normalizationConstant S.smallEtaleTopology).obj E')) ≫ (c n E').hom =
      (c (n + 1) E).hom ≫
        (constantAdicFiniteRealization g d).map (lisseTowerAlgebraArrow d n k)
